nonsevere life stressors do have an impact on the recurrence rate of depressive disorders.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
severe events are most important for the onset of depression, while nonsevere events may be more important for its recurrence.
nonsevere life stressors are important for understanding the course of recurrent depression, but that the specific stressors that are most important vary with the stage of illness.

life events are important in the onset and recurrence of depression and that they are not random events.
